1. 2. A bounded evidence agent: identify a missing fact, choose an allowlisted retrieval/comparison tool, extract numerical facts and supporting spans, compare with previously available context, detect novelty/contradictions, update a proposed thesis, and request a later reassessment. Stay within declared tool/time budgets. No generic web autonomy, wallet access, BUY/SELL output, raw confidence-as-probability assumption or invented consensus estimates.
3. AssessmentRequest.v1/AssessmentResult.v1 adapters from the common brief. Return issuer/context/model/prompt identities, evidence support, uncertainty/unknown, freshness, falsifier findings and concise public rationale. Deduplicate repeated evidence and reject late results for an obsolete thesis/profile. Unsupported or conflicting claims cause abstention. A timeout must never re-enable a buy.
4. Provider-neutral hosted/local model adapters with fixed checkpoint/prompt hashes and explicit costs/latency. First implement a verified extraction/severity baseline. Add a small trained evidence model only after rights-cleared labels, committed experiment criteria and compute/checkpoint details exist. If data are insufficient, ship the functioning inference/evaluation path with training marked NOT RUN rather than fabricating a model or claiming alpha. 5. A labeled synthetic evaluation pack: supporting-span accuracy, numerical correctness, unsupported-claim acceptance, relevant-event recall, abstention, stale-result rejection, latency and tool budget. Add held-out real-data evaluation only after source rights and availability are verified. Freeze thresholds before evaluation; compare additional reasoning/tool calls against the simple baseline.

One trace must demonstrate useful autonomous tool selection and thesis revision; another must demonstrate justified abstention. No policy/signer commands are reachable.
